site_name: LAND AT THE REAR OF 46 NEWLANDS PARK, LONDON, SE26 5NE
description: An application submitted under Section 73 of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a Minor Material Amendment in connection with the planning permission (DC/24/134944) dated 12 July 2024 for the variation of Condition (2) Approved Plans in order to allow :- amend the internal configuration of the consented dwelling by reconfiguring the first floor to include a 4th bedroom. The external dimensions, and siting of the property will remain unchanged from the consented scheme but the ridge height will be increased marginally. There are some minor adjustments to the positioning of roof windows and a new directional window on the east elevation to reflect the changes to the layout. It is also proposed to replace the zinc standing-seam roofing to natural slate and the green roof is being omitted in lieu of a PV array at Land to the rear of 46 Newlands Park SE26.
